notes: Added missing stories to meet minimum and cover core logic, API integration, and testing.

GPTR-F-001-S151.title: Core Allowlist Enforcement Engine
GPTR-F-001-S151.description: Implement the core enforcement logic that validates incoming GPTReader requests against the defined allowlist schema, including collection access, query operators, field-level restrictions, and hard limits (document count, payload size). Reject or sanitize invalid requests before execution.

GPTR-F-001-S152.title: Azure Function Integration for Enforcement
GPTR-F-001-S152.description: Integrate the allowlist enforcement engine into the Azure Function entrypoint for GPTReader so that all inbound requests are validated prior to any database interaction. Ensure enforcement is mandatory and cannot be bypassed.

GPTR-F-001-S153.title: Enforcement Unit and Integration Tests
GPTR-F-001-S153.description: Develop unit and integration tests validating allowlist enforcement behavior including valid requests, rejected queries, operator restrictions, field filtering, and limit enforcement. Include negative and boundary cases aligned to SIT scenarios.
